newsitem.title: UK: UK govt actuary penalised for busting cash limits.
newsitem.headline: UK govt actuary penalised for busting cash limits.

text.p: The UK Treasury said on Friday it was cutting the budget of the Government Actuary's Department as a penalty for breaching its cash limits in 1995/96.
Economic Secretary Angela Knight said the department's net running costs limit in 1996/97 will be cut by 184,000 stg and its cash limit lowered by 201,000 stg to 6.2 million.
"The Government Actuary's Department has reported that its systems and procedures have been reviewed to prevent a recurrence of the breach," she said in a written parliamentary answer.
